text.title: Card Sorting Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to apply the Card Sorting methodology end-to-end, with step 3 expanded into the six-step card sort run (goals, cards, format, recruit, sessions, analysis) and the tree-test follow-up.

step.name: check-preconditions
step.input: The "Applies If" + "Skip If" lists from AGENTS.md.
step.action: Verify every Applies-If item holds AND no Skip-If item triggers.
step.output: Boolean: methodology applies / does not apply.
step.decision-gate: If preconditions fail, emit a skip-record naming the failed precondition and STOP.

step.name: gather-inputs
step.action: Read each input; attach its path/URL to the working artefact. Refuse to proceed if any input is unreachable.
step.decision-gate: If any input is unreachable, halt and request the source before proceeding.

step.name: apply-rules
step.input: Inputs gathered + the rules from content/01-core-rules.xml.
step.action: Walk each rule in order; record per-rule pass/fail; capture the violating snippet on any fail.
step.decision-gate: If any HARD rule fails, repair the artefact or escalate; do not return a partially-conformant output.

step.name: produce-artefact
step.input: Rule-conformant inputs + the schema in content/02-output-contract.xml.
step.action: Fill the template under `templates/card-sorting.json` according to the schema.

step.name: validate-and-handover
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-card-sorting.py --file <path>`. Fix any reported violations. Send to named owner for sign-off.
step.output: Owner-signed artefact registered with the downstream consumer.
step.decision-gate: If validator returns non-zero, do not hand over — repair and re-validate.

step.name: define-goals
step.input: IA decision the sort must inform.
step.action: State the decision before choosing cards or format (r6-define-goal-first). Goal examples: How do users group our content? What labels make sense to users? Does our current navigation match mental models?

step.name: prepare-cards
step.action: Write 30-60 cards in user language, representative of the full content set (r7-card-count-30-60).
step.decision-gate: Over 60 cards: split into sub-sorts by content area.

step.name: choose-format
step.action: Pick open (exploration), closed (validation), or hybrid (refining an existing IA) per r8-format-by-purpose.

step.name: recruit-participants
step.action: Recruit 15-20 for open, 30+ for closed, matched to the target profile (r9-recruit-by-format).
step.decision-gate: Below the floor, do not run; reschedule recruitment.

step.name: conduct-sessions
step.action: Give standard instructions with no grouping examples (r11-no-grouping-examples). Open sort: "Please organize these cards into groups that make sense to you. You can create as many groups as you need. When done, give each group a name." Closed sort: "Please place each card into one of these categories. If a card doesn't fit anywhere, put it in 'Doesn't Fit'." Ask why after each session.

step.name: analyze-results
step.action: Compute the similarity matrix and agreement per grouping; apply the thresholds in r10-similarity-thresholds and flag items under the r4 line for re-test; fill templates/results-report.md.
step.output: Results report with agreement matrix + recommended structure.

step.name: tree-test
step.action: Validate navigation with a tree test before implementation (r12-tree-test-before-implement). Pipeline: Card Sort → proposed structure → Tree Test → refined structure → implement.
